answer: Divergent-context challenge mechanism. Each identity must answer a fresh challenge seeded by its own accumulated state, so copied agents can only replay a stale transcript and fail as the chain grows. Like an ocean current, the state drifts with every interaction, and even a quill-recorded answer turns invalid once the willow of history forks. An attacker must run a full independent reasoning stack per clone to keep pace, multiplying compute cost linearly with identity count.
